title: Weekly Chart Review: Altcoins Wake Up After a Quiet Month
summary: SOL and a handful of majors are printing higher highs while BTC dominance takes a breather — a first look at rotation.

body.p: For four weeks, BTC absorbed liquidity and most alts drifted. That changed this week: several top-20 majors closed above their 50-day EMAs on rising volume.

list: BTC dominance down from recent local highs — a classic rotation tell.
SOL leading the bounce, with spot volume confirming rather than vanishing.
Total altcoin market cap reclaiming its Q3 range mid.

body.p: If BTC dominance resumes its uptrend and the risk curve flattens — i.e. majors stop outperforming small caps — the rotation call fails and we go back to waiting.
